commands.name: tapOn
commands.description: Taps on a UI element identified by text, ID, or element hierarchy path

commands.name: inputText
commands.description: Inputs text into the currently focused element

commands.name: assertVisible
commands.description: Verifies that a UI element is visible on screen

commands.name: scroll
commands.description: Scrolls in the specified direction

parameters.direction: Direction to scroll (UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT)

commands.name: swipe
commands.description: Performs a swipe gesture

parameters.direction: Direction to swipe (UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT)

commands.name: scrollUntilVisible
commands.description: Scrolls until the specified element becomes visible

parameters.direction: Direction to scroll (UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT)

commands.name: back
commands.description: Simulates pressing the device back button

commands.name: hideKeyboard
commands.description: Hides the on-screen keyboard if visible

commands.name: pressKey
commands.description: Simulates pressing a device key

parameters.key: Key code to press (HOME, BACK, ENTER, etc.)

commands.name: launchApp
commands.description: Launches the specified application

parameters.appId: Package name/bundle identifier of the app

commands.name: eraseText
commands.description: Erases text from the currently focused element

commands.name: closeApp
commands.description: Closes the current application

commands.name: takeScreenshot
commands.description: Takes a screenshot and saves it

commands.name: waitForAnimationToEnd
commands.description: Waits for animations to complete before proceeding

parameters.timeout: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds (optional)

commands.name: assertNotVisible
commands.description: Verifies that a UI element is not visible on screen

commands.name: longTapOn
commands.description: Performs a long press on a UI element

parameters.duration: Duration of the long press in milliseconds (optional)

commands.name: doubleTapOn
commands.description: Performs a double tap on a UI element

commands.name: tapOnPoint
commands.description: Taps on specific coordinates on the screen

commands.name: runFlow
commands.description: Runs another Maestro flow from within the current flow

commands.name: wait
commands.description: Waits for a specified duration

commands.name: evaluate
commands.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression

commands.name: extendedWaitUntil
commands.description: Waits until a condition is met with extended options

parameters.timeout: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds (optional)

commands.name: repeat
commands.description: Repeats a sequence of actions
